# Bundled assets

The `material_*.xml` drawables are Google's official Material Symbols Outlined Android vectors. Source pattern:

`https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/android/<name>/materialsymbolsoutlined/<name>_24px.xml`

Names: settings, sunny, clear_night, partly_cloudy_day, partly_cloudy_night, cloud, rainy, weather_snowy, thunderstorm and foggy. Original viewports/path geometry and aspect ratios are preserved; theme tint is removed and local neutral/sun colours are applied. Copyright Google LLC; Apache License 2.0, reproduced in `material-icons-LICENSE.txt`, `res/raw/material_icons_license.txt` and Settings → Open source licences.

App banners and icons are loaded from packages installed on the device and are not bundled or recreated.
